svg.title: Ceduljica · original plaza world and expressive cast
svg.desc: Approved crops of original Ceduljica sources show welcoming and celebrating Peel, Dot, Zip and Loop. A sunny world study is paired with an authored paper stage and reusable framing guidance. No generated text or unsupported props are adopted.

svg.text: Warmth, bounce and a calm place for everyone's thought. Original Ceduljica source family.

g.text: Peel
Yellow folded note · welcoming
Invites; never substitutes for instructions.
Dot
Sky circle · springy and open
Round body; tiny limbs, big expression.
Zip
Mint triangle · eager and elastic
Distinct silhouette, rosy cheeks, ink eyes.
Loop
Lavender rounded square · joyful
Wide eyes are face geometry, not props.
The world: sunny depth, not a decorative stripe
The selected original source is retained whole as visual evidence.
The translation: a quiet paper stage
One thought. Plenty of space.
No motifs behind text or controls.
One tape tab. Level writing surface.
Hard offset; folded edge outside the copy.
Approved original scenery crop + authored vector ribbons and paper.
Use the bounce. Keep the boundaries.
One or two pals at an edge; each ≤18% of the viewport's short side.
No costumes, props, moustaches, envelope folds or borrowed characters.
Organic green silhouettes, coral arches, broad ribbons and generous sky gaps.
One energetic accent per view; never scatter bursts over the writing surface.
Decorative art is aria-hidden. At 320 px / 200% zoom, secondary pals disappear first. Reduced motion: static.

svg.text: Source reuse is approved for these references only. Generated words, UI, unrelated icons and unsupported variants are not product requirements.
